title: Tinderwick - Lantern Lullaby
_note: SOURCE town theme + first full statement of the Vesper motif. gbc 4-voice band. 92 BPM, 4/4, C major with a wistful A-minor turn in the answer phrase. 16-bar AABA-leaning loop. Lead = slow tender Vesper motif (G3->C4->D4 lift ... E4->D4->C4 settle). Harmony = slow music-box broken-chord arp (C-E-G, A-C-E under minor turn), low gain. Bass = warm rocking root-fifth hearth pulse, 2 notes/bar. Percussion = near-absent, one soft noise tick on bar downbeats.

tracks._note: A: full Vesper statement. A': repeat. B: A-minor homesick turn (the catch in the throat). A'': resolve home.
